deficiencies.description: The rewrite inserts the causal conjunction 'because' to link the prevalence of benign tumours to the difficulty of their becoming malignant, creating a causal relationship not stated in the source text.

deficiencies.caseForAllowed: The speaker's conversational transition 'So it actually takes a lot... So they're extremely common' could be read as implying a logical connection between the two points.
